articles.title: 'Preventable disease': Delhi govt to notify human rabies under Epidemic Diseases Act, targets 0 deaths
articles.summary: The Delhi government will notify human rabies under the Epidemic Diseases Act, making it a notifiable disease. This proactive measure aims to enhance surveillance, reporting, and control efforts against the preventable disease. With a clear objective to achieve zero rabies deaths, this initiative underscores Delhi's commitment to public health and preventative healthcare strategies.

articles.title: Could I survive the quietest place on Earth?
articles.summary: The article explores survival in the quietest place on Earth, an anechoic chamber. It concludes that physical survival is likely, but mental sanity would be severely tested. The chamber's complete silence makes one acutely aware of self-generated bodily sounds, which can be profoundly disorienting and challenging to psychological well-being.

articles.title: South Korea's Lee Jae Myung to meet China's Xi in reset of relations
articles.summary: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung is set to meet Chinese leader Xi Jinping, aiming to reset frayed diplomatic and economic ties. China, being South Korea's largest trading partner, makes this summit crucial for stabilizing bilateral relations. The high-level engagement seeks to mend strained connections and foster renewed cooperation, impacting regional stability and trade dynamics.
